description.name: Entry
description.text: Causes [Imperil Lightning 20% (15s)], grants [Buff Lightning 20% (15s)] to all allies, grants [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Shelke], [Apex Synaptic Net Dive Ability Tracker] and [Apex Synaptic Net Dive Level] to the user

description.name: Buff Lightning 20% (15s)
description.text: Increases Lightning damage dealt by 20%, cumulable

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Shelke
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Synaptic Net Dive (0~2), removed after using Apex Synaptic Net Dive two times

description.name: Apex Synaptic Net Dive Ability Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Synaptic Net Dive level by 1 after using 7 Celerity or Support abilities during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Shelke]

description.name: Apex Synaptic Net Dive Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Synaptic Net Dive level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Shelke]
